comparison.objective: Restock a spring-loaded shelf lane while preserving stock order; candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber through repeated impact tests.
comparison.physical_skill: PR holds a resisting pusher while placing cartons. Candidate performs fine hex-bit engagement, captive-screw torque, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires four ordered cartons and a released pusher at 9.2–11.0 cm. Candidate requires two safe ≥0.85 J axial stops within travel, velocity, force, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities and physical outcomes differ meaningfully: bimanual resisted loading versus precision adjustment followed by dynamic damping validation.
